John spent $200 on blue ties at $40 each, so he bought 200 / 40 = 5 blue ties. He bought twice as many red ties, so 2 × 5 = 10 red ties. Red ties cost 50% more than blue ties, so each red tie costs $40 + 0.5 × $40 = $60. Thus, the cost of red ties is 10 × $60 = $600. Total spent on ties is $200 + $600 = $800.

Answer: 800
